C187.name: Kati District
C187.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Kati: central farmland and Jozani forest
area.sw: Kati: mashamba ya kati na msitu wa Jozani

risk.en: This area has central farmland and the Jozani forest, where low ground floods in heavy rain and dry spells and fires affect crops and forest.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya kati na msitu wa Jozani, ambapo ardhi ya chini hufurika wakati wa mvua kubwa na vipindi vya ukavu na moto huathiri mazao na misitu.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes off low ground, burn only under control and protect forest cover. What raises the risk and to the loss in a dry spell: building in the low ground that floods, burning fields on windy days near the forest edge, cutting Jozani trees for poles or charcoal, and relying on one crop on the thin soils. Know the higher ground your household will move to when the low fields flood, and the cleared open ground you will go to if a fire comes from the forest; agree early where food and water will come from when the dry spell runs long. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya ardhi ya chini, kuchoma kwa udhibiti tu na kulinda misitu. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara wakati wa kiangazi: kujenga kwenye ardhi ya chini inayofurika, kuchoma mashamba siku za upepo karibu na mpaka wa msitu, kukata miti ya Jozani kwa nguzo au mkaa, na kutegemea zao moja kwenye udongo mwembamba. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia mashamba ya chini yanapofurika, na uwanja wazi uliosafishwa mtakaoenda moto ukija kutoka msituni; kubalianeni mapema chakula na maji vitatoka wapi kiangazi kikirefuka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C188.name: Kusini District
C188.documented: large waves on the south and east shores, strong winds, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Kusini: Paje, Makunduchi and south-east coast
area.sw: Kusini: Paje, Makunduchi na pwani ya kusini-mashariki

risk.en: This area has east-coast tourist and seaweed-farming villages where erosion and storm tides threaten the shore and seaweed farmers face rough seas and heat.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya utalii na kilimo cha mwani vya pwani ya mashariki ambapo mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa huhatarisha ufukwe na wakulima wa mwani hukabiliwa na bahari chafu na joto.

advice.en: For those living, farming seaweed and running tourism here, it helps to build back from the shore, avoid the sea in strong winds and protect yourself from the sun. What raises the risk: building hotels and houses on the beach, breaking coral or cutting the shore vegetation, going out to the seaweed plots or taking boats out when the wind is rising, and working the reef flat through the midday heat without water. Know the higher ground inland that residents and guests will move to when a storm-tide or strong-wind warning is given, and agree with the hotels and the sheha how guests will be warned and moved; on very hot days, work the plots early and late, not at midday. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima mwani na kufanya utalii hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na ufukwe, kuepuka bahari upepo mkali unapovuma na kujikinga na jua. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga hoteli na nyumba ufukweni, kuvunja matumbawe au kukata mimea ya ufukweni, kwenda kwenye mashamba ya mwani au kutoa vyombo upepo unapopanda, na kufanya kazi kwenye tambarare ya matumbawe wakati wa joto kali la mchana bila maji. Fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo wakazi na wageni watahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba au upepo mkali inapotolewa, na kubalianeni na hoteli na sheha jinsi wageni watakavyotahadharishwa na kuhamishwa; siku za joto kali, fanyeni kazi mashambani asubuhi na jioni, si mchana. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
